figures.caption: Antibacterial assays with peptide RP1 against (a) E. faecalis (b) S. aureus and (c) E. coli. The methodology followed the guidelines of the Clinical and Laboratory Standers Institute (CLSI, 2012). Three independent experiments were performed and the data were analyzed by applying the one-way ANOVA with Tukey's post hoc test using GraphPad Prism Version 5.01 software (GraphPad Software Inc., La Jolla, CA, USA). The maximum coefficient of variation accepted was 25%, the confidence level was 95% (p <0.05) and ***p<0.001, *p<0.05; **p<0.01; ns: not significant.
